name: Poem Mountain
summary: You look at a 106 m hill over Cửa Lục. Three sides are houses. The west and south meet the bay. The cluster includes chùa Long Tiên, đền Đức Ông, the old post office center, a 12.7 mm gun site, and air-raid caves 1 through 6. A Party flag was raised here on the morning of 1 May 1930. A visit time and a fee were not printed.
getThere: On the Hong Gai shore. A minute from Bai Chay was not printed.
heroCaption: The hill, the flag, the roofs, and the bay
gettingThere: The cluster page places the hill in phường Hồng Gai. From Bãi Cháy you cross Cầu Bãi Cháy. A walk minute was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Bai Chay
legs.body: Across Cầu Bãi Cháy to the Hồng Gai shore. A minute was not printed. Check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. A visit time was not printed. Daylight, so the flag and the hill read together.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed.
admissionNote: A fee was not printed. Check on arrival. The hill was ranked a national relic by Quyết định 1140-QĐ/BT on 31 August 1992. Chùa Long Tiên, built in 1941 under the Nguyễn court with a three-door gate, shares that ranking. Đền Đức Ông shares it too. The temple courtyard is 2,531.8 m² in a 2011 decision and 2,689.8 m² in a 2013 adjustment.
